name: Magical Mooncakes
source:
In the mystical embrace of ancient China, where the autumn wind carries both a chill and a promise, the village of Yuehua celebrates the Mid-Autumn Festival with a flurry of colors and lights.

Here, in this lantern-lit haven, two souls, Luo Ye and Si Qiu, both adept in the arcane arts and the ancient craft of mooncake baking, find themselves in a gentle rivalry woven with threads of potential romance.

[From [url=https://hasalynxgames.itch.io/magical-mooncakes-a-mid-autumn-festival-adventure-lesbian-romance-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在古老中国的神秘怀抱里，秋风带着寒意，也带着希望，月华村在色彩缤纷、灯光璀璨中庆祝中秋。

在这里，在这个灯笼照亮的天堂里，两个灵魂，洛叶和斯秋，都擅长神秘艺术和古老的月饼烘焙工艺，发现自己陷入了一场温柔的竞争，其中交织着潜在的浪漫。

[来自[url=https://hasalynxgames.itch.io/magical-mooncakes-a-mid-autumn-festival-adventure-lesbian-romance-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
